rules.rule: No colour outside the six palette hexes for type, grounds, panels, rules, chart marks, icons or recovered act wordmarks.
Pitch, Bone White and Sodium (for every date line) are mandatory palette colours.
Grounds and panels are Pitch or Ash and nothing else.
Pitch is the main ground of every poster, post and deck page.
Every act name is Bone White on Pitch.
Each act name has its date line directly above it in Sodium.
Every other line of type (titles, headings, support, door, set, body, billing, table and fine print) is Bone White.
Cold Signal and Blood are accents for hairline rules, dividers and chart marks only, together no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area.
Supplied production act wordmarks are recoloured to Bone White on Pitch, in one solid palette colour.
